chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 05 (Unit 17 & 18: Biotechnology & Pharmacology)
subject: biology-10

questions.question: Which single-celled fungus is widely utilized in industrial biotechnology for alcoholic fermentation? (FBISE Annual 2024)
questions.explanation: Saccharomyces cerevisiae ferments simple sugars into ethanol and carbon dioxide under anaerobic conditions.

questions.question: In recombinant DNA technology, which enzymes are referred to as molecular scissors because they cut DNA at specific palindromic sequences? (FBISE 2023)
questions.explanation: Restriction endonucleases cleave phosphodiester backbones at specific recognition sites, producing sticky or blunt ends for gene splicing.

questions.question: Small circular extrachromosomal DNA molecules found in bacteria that serve as gene-carrying vectors are: (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Plasmids are autonomous self-replicating genetic elements in bacteria widely used as cloning vectors in recombinant DNA work.

questions.question: What was the first commercial therapeutic pharmaceutical protein produced in genetically modified bacteria? (FBISE 2022)
questions.explanation: Human insulin (Humulin) was successfully synthesized in recombinant E. coli, providing pure, non-allergenic insulin for diabetic therapy.

questions.question: Golden Rice was genetically engineered with foreign genes to biosynthesize which vital human nutrient? (FBISE 2021)
questions.explanation: Golden Rice synthesizes beta-carotene in its edible endosperm to combat malnutrition and childhood blindness in developing nations.

questions.question: A large stainless-steel vessel designed to maintain optimal environmental control for large-scale microbial cultures is a:
questions.explanation: Fermenters (bioreactors) regulate temperature, pH, aeration, and agitation for industrial-scale biosynthesis of antibiotics and proteins.

questions.question: Which narcotic opioid analgesic is naturally extracted from the latex of the opium poppy (Papaver somniferum)? (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Morphine is a potent opioid analgesic derived from the opium poppy, prescribed for profound acute clinical pain relief.

questions.question: Antibiotics that directly kill target bacteria by disrupting cell wall or membrane integrity are: (FBISE 2023)
questions.explanation: Bactericidal drugs (e.g., penicillins) kill bacteria outright, whereas bacteriostatic drugs halt bacterial division.

questions.question: Who discovered the first clinical antibiotic, penicillin, from a contaminated fungal mold culture in 1928? (FBISE 2024)
questions.explanation: Sir Alexander Fleming noted bacterial lysis around Penicillium mold colonies on a staphylococcal plate in 1928.

questions.question: Who developed the world first vaccine in 1796 using cowpox inoculation against smallpox? (FBISE 2022)
questions.explanation: Edward Jenner demonstrated that inoculation with benign cowpox fluid conferred acquired immunity against lethal smallpox.

questions.question: Sedative medications primarily exert their pharmacological action by: (FBISE 2021)

options.A: Stimulating heart rate and motor agitation
options.B: Depressing central nervous system activity to calm anxiety and induce drowsiness

questions.explanation: Sedatives dampen neuronal excitability in the central nervous system, calming agitation and inducing sleep.

questions.question: Which of the following is an illicit hallucinogenic drug derived from the Indian hemp plant (Cannabis sativa)?
questions.explanation: Marijuana and hashish are cannabinoid products containing psychoactive THC derived from Cannabis sativa.
